140000.description:
Countess Ashley recalled her previous life as a black rabbit of the demon tribe that was killed by the conquering hero. One day, she was betrothed to His Royal Highness Clyde, the descendant of the hero. Ashley was terrified and avoided him as much as she could, but he kept coming on to her with a mischievous smile...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 王弟殿下のお気に入り 転生しても天敵から逃げられないようです!?
title.romaji: Outei Denka no Okiniiri Tensei shite mo Tenteki kara Nigerarenai you desu?!

title.native: 真面目系天然令嬢は年下王子の想いに気づかない
title.romaji: Majimekei Tenren wa Toshishita Ouji no Omoi ni Kizukanai

140003.description:
I'm an outstanding white-collar worker called Zhao Tianqi. I got poisoned after going back in time. I even had to become a weird man's concubine. Alas, forget it.

When I get the chance, I will try my best to show you how smart I am. Besides excellence in work, I can also handle the harem issue. If I play my cards right, I can turn from a concubine into the mistress.

Become a concubine in another world? Her target is of course to get divorced and become single again.

(Source: Webcomics)

140004.description: Accused of seducing cruel tycoon Gu Moyan and using him to gain fame, third-rate model Su Nian’an was warned never to show her face before Gu Moyan again. Despite the injustice behind the accusation, Su Nian’an was determined to avoid Gu Moyan at all cost. The Universe, however, had other ideas. By some cruel twist of fate, Su Nian’an ran into the tycoon at a dinner party. What would become of Su Nian’an? Would she face the dire consequences of a crime she’d never even committed? Or would she be able to thaw the cold heart of Gu Moyan and change her life forever?

140010.description: Riko (Ritsuko) is the daughter of the head of a hospital situated in South Africa. When Riko's parents do not return from their search of crucial medicine, it's up to her and a colorful crew from around the world to search for them.

140013.description:
There are two men who will start fighting once they see each other. They won’t be friends anyway. So what kind of relationship will they have? The cold and proud high-class boy meets with a rebellious and edgy lad. They got an unsolved grudge during high school. Just when they thought they would never see each other again, they became neighbors who would meet every day at university! What will happen to them this time? What stories will they create?

(Source: Webnovel)

140014.description:
In the world of the Cloud Pact Sanctuary, magic cultivators and contract demons coexist in harmony. After being recruited by the sanctuary’s founder, the young cultivating prodigy, Xie Tong, begins his journey as a superstar among his peers. But things take an unpredictable turn! Xie’s stoic facade crumbles when he meets a weak fox demon named Zhiyi who will do anything to please him... anything but cultivate magic. Can this couple overcome their power differences to form a contract—and more importantly, a deeper bond?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Cultivator and His Contract Demon

140015.description:
A sudden blizzard swept over the earth. What should have been a blazing hot summer has turned into extreme winter cold. Everywhere, it looked like the end of the world. Even worse, fearsome and deadly creatures hide beneath the thick snow... they are the Snowmen...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

140016.description:
22-years-old Shen Qianling attained the status of the King of the Silver Screen for the first time in his life. Afterward, while he was holding his trophy and breaming with tears of happiness, a piece of ceiling fell with a loud bang, smashing onto his head accurately. After that, he… transmigrated! Qin Shaoyu: If Ling’er is willing to, Zhui Ying Palace can hold a wedding any time. Shen Qianling: To tell you the truth, I am very unwilling.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: There Are Weirdos All Over Jianghu

140017.description:
Eight years ago, the innocent, rich heir Jiang Yumian pursued his tutor Qin Heng; eight years later, the roles are reversed. The noveau rich Qin Heng reunites with his first love Yumian by chance. This time, he decides he will hold tight to him and not let go.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

140018.description:
Isshi Nozaki, a friendly guy working as a bouncer at an all-female staff night club for men, comes to the rescue of a homeless man being harassed and ends up taking him home.
After a bath and a shave, Isshi can't help but marvel at the man's transformation, only to get pushed into bed with the man pulling down his pants?!
A young man with a jaded past meets a homeless guy with his own issues to work out.
Can they heal each other's hearts...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Romance Of Water And Ash
title.native: 灰と水。それからロマンス

140021.description:
A marriage announcement from his first love! That night, after giving into his despair and getting drunk, Akira forced his first love’s younger brother to sleep with him. Through the years, Haruto started looking more and more like his older brother, so Akira tried to avoid him. He didn’t want to develop any strange feelings towards Haruto, but it still ended up happening…! Akira is afraid that he traumatized Haruto, who genuinely tried to care for him. But then… ”Don’t act like that in front of anyone but me.” After just one night, he suddenly acts like a boyfriend!? An extremely cheerful Haruto starts chasing after him, and although surprised, Akira follows his lead. It wasn’t supposed to be serious at first. But Haruto becomes more and more important to Akira as he sees Haruto’s admirable devotion…

(Source: East Press, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I Hit On My Crush's Younger Brother When I Got Drunk

title.native: 泥酔して襲ったのは好きな人の弟でした。
title.romaji: Deisui Shite Osotta no wa Suki na Hito no Otouto Deshita.

title.native: 俺のこと好きなくせに！
title.romaji: Ore no Koto Suki na Kuse ni!

140025.description: A story about two people who have a suspicious appearance but a gentle personality.

title.native: 見るからに怪しい二人

140030.description:
Riko Sasamoto has treasured the bittersweet memories of her unrequited love from high school. But 10 years later, she is reunited with her crush Shirai-kun at work, and they start dating! Their first date, the first kiss, and the first time... Riko's heart is on the verge of exploding from all the "firsts" that come one after another!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

synonyms: Ten Minutes Later the Police Came
Juppun  Ato ni Keisatsu wa Kita

title.english: Ten Minutes Later, The Cops Showed Up

title.native: サキュバスリメンバー！

140041.description:
I don’t want to work. Like at all. But I don’t have a choice. On an Earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Aliens live together, there is a never-ending series of incidents. This is the story of a man that’s had to work in secrecy for 800 years because he’ll die if he doesn’t.

(Source: Naver, translated)

140042.description:
The daughter of a noble family deep in debt, Irina Nordiak’s only desire is to marry her long-time love Ludwig Fontern, but her financial situation prevents this. With no other options, she calls upon an old schoolmate, Ileanor Schuberg, who is now a wealthy lord. While cruel to others, he acts like a different person to Irina, pining over her while detesting her love for Ludwig. Though he agrees to pay off Irina’s debt in exchange for her servitude, he has no intention of letting her leave.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ทะเลแห่งอนารยธรรมอันงดงาม

140045.description:
An immensely powerful and ancient dragon, once worshipped as a god by humans but now only a myth in their eyes, wakes up one day to find a human girl poking around his lair. The infant is barely old enough to say her own name, but is quite confident in calling the dragon “Daddy”! Bewildered by the unexpected visitor, the dragon soon learns that returning her to human civilization isn’t going to be an option...not yet, anyway. He quickly decides to raise the girl himself, determined to give her a happy life that will lead her back to human society when she is older—surely a simple task for a legendary being such as himself. All he needs to do now is find a place for her to sleep. And figure out where he is going to get clothes for her. And...wait, what do humans eat again?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Dragon Daddy Diaries: A Girl Grows to Greatness
title.native: 突然パパになった最強ドラゴンの子育て日記～かわいい娘、ほのぼのと人間界最強に育つ～
title.romaji: Totsuzen Papa ni Natta Saikyou Dragon no Kosodate Nikki: Kawaii Musume, Honobono to Ningenkai Saikyou ni Sodatsu

140047.description:
Hiroshi went on a trip to visit Hiyose, attracted by its natural beauty and by the taste of the local potato shochu he once drank. On the train, he met a beautiful girl named Minako. She was fighting alone to protect the natural scenery and the fireflies of Hiyose, which were about to be destroyed by the construction of a paper mill. Hiroshi fell in love with Minako, and on the night of the summer festival, he witnessed a shocking scene.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

140048.description:
The male lead supported and believed in science ever since he was young and had a naturally unsociable disposition. However, since he was born in a family whose maternal lineage were sorcerers, he was cast out of the clan due to his lack of magical powers. He and his younger sister depended on each other thereafter. One day, the male lead noticed that his sister had gone missing and heard rumours about the Demon King’s evil doings. Believing that the Demon King had abducted his sister, he decided to crossdress to infiltrate the Demon King’s city to save his sister. Unexpectedly, the Demon King is actually a handsome guy who likes making dresses?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Demon King Wants to be Friends with Me
title.romaji: Mowang Xiang Gen Wo Jiao Pengyou

140049.description:
Tang, a charming noble, almost met his end at the hands of a sleazy prince. Luckily, he awakens to find himself in the home of Cheng, the stunning stranger-turned-bandit who saved him! While recovering in the mountains, the unlikely pair form a bond, but they eventually go their separate ways. Even so, they can’t stop thinking about each other... is there a happily ever after for them, or will their conflicts tear their love apart?

(Source: Tapas)

140050.description:
Zhou Mingyu, a college student who possesses the bizarre power called Tiangou became targeted by various powerful forces in the warlock world. To free himself from Tiangou's influence and to find the truth of his father’s death, a mysterious incident that happened more than a hundred years ago in Kunlun Mountain will be unveiled….

(Source: Tencent, translated)

140051.description:
Kouya is reunited with Aihime, a girl he used to play with when they were little, for the first time in nine years.
Even though they've lived far apart, Kouya's feelings for her have been growing through their social media exchanges, and he decided to take the opportunity of their reunion to reveal his feelings to her!
But she has a secret...?

(Source: Manga Cross, translated)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
synonyms: Still, I want to make you happy

title.native: それでも君を幸せにしたい
title.romaji: Soredemo Kimi wo Shiawase ni Shitai

140052.description:
The social outcast, Seria, had changed.

Seria Shuteren, the vile woman who had everyone trembling with fear at her feet, was now calm. Truthfully, the woman had not just changed; she was a completely different person. Realizing she had possessed the wicked woman's body in this romance novel, she decided to live on the low, having a hunch about the future.

She would end Seria's dreadful habits and successfully avoid her death by decapitation at the hands of Kalis, the sub male lead!
synonyms: The Case of the Legal Villain

140053.description:
The sickly and socially withdrawn Princess Ridelle fell in love with the quick-witted knight, Sir Oscar, and became his wife. But after finding out that Oscar didn't wish for the marriage, their marriage life became no different than a pile of misfortunes.

Soon, Ridelle was struck down by another tragedy, changing both of their lives tremendously, but...

This is the love story between a former princess who was looked down upon as "the Failure Princess," and the young count known as "the Ice Knight"—the crossing of their paths weaving tragedies in their wake.

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: Dear Sir, to Us Who Were "Ice Knight and Mediocre Princess"
경애하는 「얼음 기사와 못난이 공주」 였던 우리들에게
Gyeongaehaneun Tedeoreum Gisawa Monnani Gongjutel Yeotdeon Urideurege

title.native: 拝啓「氷の騎士とはずれ姫」だったわたしたちへ
title.romaji: Haikei "Kouri no Kishi to Hazure-hime" Datta Watashitachi e

title.native: パラダイムパラサイトパラダイス

140055.description:
The sickly and socially withdrawn Princess Ridelle fell in love with the quick-witted knight, Sir Oscar, and became his wife. But after finding out that Oscar didn't wish for the marriage, their marriage life became no different than a pile of misfortunes.

Soon, Ridelle was struck down by another tragedy, changing both of their lives tremendously, but...

This is the love story between a former princess who was looked down upon as "the Failure Princess," and the young count known as "the Ice Knight"—the crossing of their paths weaving tragedies in their wake.

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: Dear Sir, to Us Who Were "Ice Knight and Mediocre Princess"

title.native: 拝啓「氷の騎士とはずれ姫」だったわたしたちへ
title.romaji: Haikei "Kouri no Kishi to Hazure-hime" Datta Watashitachi e

140057.description:
The world is in peril. Legends live, fairy tales walk, and fantasies become reality, threatening to turn Earth into a waking nightmare. When the flames of war reach Japan’s shores, the vestiges of a shattered nation fail to protect what remains of its people against an unknown enemy, and all seems lost. Those left behind and those that failed to flee now live in scattered communities among the remnants of a better time. Yu Ichinose is just another survivor, a quiet, scrawny middle-schooler trying to get by. That is, until he finds his fate bound to a mysterious, elvish girl who seems to hold the key to hope. Now, the time has come to stand and take up the sword against sorcery. To become the hero who saves the world. The time has come to awaken the Asura Frame.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Fantasy Has Invaded, Hero Come Back

140058.description: Gitae, who quit his job and has been lazing around the house, saw a poster for recruiting part-timers at a fitness center. With the fantasy of getting a nice body and to avoid his mother's nagging, he applied. And at the gym, he got to see the fantastic chest of the trainer, Soohyeon. At that brief moment which made Gitae's heart race, he almost got injured... but it was Soohyeon who got hurt after saving him. Afterwards, Soohyeon asks a favor from Gitae that he couldn't refuse since he was feeling apologetic...

140060.description:
Manga artist Oshiga Sukoya is in love with the Vtuber Doujima Taiga and constantly gushes about her to her best friend Hariyama Teruko. Little does Sukoya know that Teruko is A.) the person behind Doujima Taiga, and B.) secretly in love with Sukoya.

Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, it was collected for publication by Futabasha on 2023-09-21.
synonyms: My Best Friend Who I Love Fell Completely in Love With My Vtuber Self

title.native: 大好きな親友がVチューバーの自分にガチ恋してた話
title.romaji: Daisuki na Shinyuu ga VTuber no Jibun ni Gachi Koishiteta Hanashi

140061.description:
Living in the city can be tough. Living with magicians can be tougher. Rangse Enna worked hard to pass the government official exam. After being stationed to work for the government in the city, she bravely left her hometown… only to be housed with the magicians. The apartment seems to be full of strange magicians who operate differently from the people Rangse used to know. Will she be able to adjust to her new job, new city, and her new apartment?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.native: 裏表ぺっとらいあんぐる

140063.description:
Hyeon-woo is forced to go on a blind date because of a friend's heartbreaking request. When I met someone on a blind date, I was going to say no and go back, but the blind date I met 'Do-hyun' is Hyeon-woo ideal type!
Hyeon-woo falls in love at first sight and starts living with Do-hyun that day. Then one day, a man comes to see the two of them happily...

140064.description:
Despite his parents' objections, Daisuke Shiro, a young teacher, took a job at a small school in the countryside. He was not welcomed by the villagers and their children, who saw him as an outsider. However, as Daisuke treated his students with compassion, they gradually come to understand each other. Daisuke and the students practiced hard for the big sports day competition between the local villages, and their bond is further strengthened.

At the same time, children of migrant workers, who have been neglected due to the absence of their parents, came to the village and caused trouble. Daisuke struggled to resolve the conflict between the children.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

140065.description:
Everyone loves fairy tales. But who is the strongest of them all? This is a story of death and rebirth. The fairy tale protagonists fight each other to the death to achieve their hopes, hatreds, and salvation!

(Source: LINE Comics, translated)

140068.description: In his previous life, Lin Xiao accidentally obtained the God’s Resolution Sutra and awakened the ancient ancestor body, an unparalleled overlord body. After all kinds of hardships, he eventually became an immortal and conquered the gods and demons. Now, he’s reborn and returned to his teenage, seventeen years old self…

title.english: Return of the Reborn God Emperor
title.romaji: Chong Sheng Zhi Shen Dì Gui Lai

140069.description:
I dedicated eight years to help him rule his empire, only for him to send me to my death by burning!

My last wish before death was to be reborn so I can change my fate, and not make the same stupid mistake again!
However… I was reborn into the body of my sworn enemy?!

My revenge plan is proceeding smoothly, but a prince suddenly appeared and proposed marriage? Does he not know I already have 4 prince consorts?

140070.description:
A girl is treated like an outcast because of a prophecy. After an injury, she awakened memories of a past life as an office worker, and she decided to leave behind her original family to find someone more worthy of her love. But her twin sister was still bound by the prophecy to stay with her original family for life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 穿成炮灰女配该怎么办
title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Paohui Nüpei Gai Zenmeban

140071.description:
It was late at night. Bai Yimeng the drama actress went to a ramen restaurant for dinner after a toilsome rehearsal. At that time the news about Wu Suowei was being broadcast on television. All guests present took strong interest in this star of the police force and talked about him. What everyone didn’t know was, Wu Suowei himself was drinking beer in silence alongside Bai Yimeng. Just a story about solving a case, Oh No! This is where the romance begins.

(Source: Wecomics)

140072.description:
All it took was one meet-up, a simple meet-up with his MMO wife and suddenly he was dragged into the world of urban cultivation. Thus he believed that he would begin his journey as a cultivator in this urban world and live a life of overbearing dominance. However...why is life as a cultivator so hard and so impoverished? How come everyone's still playing the MMO even though they're piss poor? Wait a minute...playing the MMO is part of cultivation too?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: My MMO Wife Is a Cultivator

140073.description:
"This child is not my daughter."

Ariel was born in the Marquis family, where she was abused and abandoned. She ended up with a miserable death after a life of endless misfortune. Then she woke up, and she was nine years old again. In order to not repeat her miserable life, Ariel decides to have a contractual marriage with the son of the grand duke, Lakarter, who is famous for blood and madness.

"What are all these keys for?"

The housekeeper glanced at the keys and laughed.

"These keys are for the treasury of the grand duke’s family."

She can use all of them as she pleases because they are all hers.

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

Note: This is a promotional oneshot for the web novel of the same name.

140074.description:
"How does it feel to be kissed and touched by me...?"

Haru is a hairdresser and childhood friend to Michiko, who only sees him as a younger brother. Although he's not her boyfriend, he's been the person closest to Michiko. However, ever since she started husband-hunting, he's been panicking! Despite Haru's multiple approaches to woo Michiko, she was so oblivious that none of them worked. Desperate to win, Haru decides to make a move with his body instead?

"What do I have to do to make you see me as a man?"

The struggles of a handsome hairdresser trying to win his oblivious childhood friend's heart!! A teasing love story that will give you butterflies!

title.native: こじらせくんの欲しい人

140075.description:
This is a coming-of-age story about Yuno, the third-generation of the family running Hananoyu, a public bathhouse in downtown Asakusa that has been in operation for 97 years, and her friends, Atsuki and Meguru.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

140084.description:
1. Shiroi Yakusoku (白い約束)
2. Hitchhike (ヒッチハイク)
3. Fruits Koumori (フルーツこうもり)
4. Watashi ga Neko ha ni Natta wake (私がネコ派になったわけ)

title.native: 精霊伝説ヒューディー
勤め先の娘さんをおいしく頂く本 民宿編
title.romaji: Tsutomesaki no Musume-san wo Oishiku Itadaku Hon Minshuku Hen

140089.description: Kenji Kazemaki, aka The Hurricane Kid, is a masked wrestler in the American pro-wrestling scene. He was a Japanese judo prodigy, but had to give up judo to help pay for the trial of his father, who was accused of a crime he did not commit. He was recruited to become the first Japanese member of the elite FBI team, and his father's name was cleared with the help of the FBI. After completing his rigorous training, Kenji received his first order: return to Japan to defend it against a gang infiltrating the country.

140090.description: Daitoh Tai, who won national titles in several sports, was fascinated by pro-wrestling and joined Japan Pro Wrestling, an organization ran by Rikidozan. He overcame the disadvantage of his small size with his training as he battled against powerful opponents such as Chief Reaper, Mr. 50 Megaton, The Coconuts, and Dr. Schmidt. Tai grew into a strong wrestler under the encouragement of a young girl named Ruriko who ran an orphanage, his classmate and best friend Goro, and the strict guidance of his mentor Rikidozan.

140091.description:
"Can you take a picture of a ghost? For me?"

Shoshin, whose hobby is photography, saw Ei Ubara by himself after school, with tears in his beautiful lime green eyes, drawing a picture of someone without a face. Struck by Ei's appearance, Shoshin found him in school the next day and asked Ei to be his photo model. Ei initially refused, but Shoshin wouldn't give up, so Ei imposed some conditions to be his model...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

140093.description:
A semi-autobiographical manga documenting the life and work of a popular manga artist. The story centers on a free-spirited young man who wants to become a mangaka assistant, and comically describes the human relationships among the mangaka's family, assistants, and editors.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

140095.description:
This novel depicts the process of main characters Gong Seong-Hyeon and Chung Tae-Gyeong finding true love. Raised by parents in a loveless marriage, Gong Seong-Hyeong has a pessimistic view of love and marriage and only has superficial relationships. Meanwhile, love columnist Chung Tae-Gyeong sees love as a matter of "give and take" and gives love advice to others, but hasn't been able to find true love for himself. After several failed attempts free at love, two men with completely different attitudes and values eventually find true love with each other while growing together and accepting one another in their lives.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

140096.description:
Asahi Suzuki, a manga artist, receives a letter from Takamine Yamamoto, a student from his nursery school days. Feeling nostalgic, Suzuki meets Takamine and deepens their relationship. Takamine had left his mother and was living in an orphanage. Is it possible to raise someone else's son?　 Does it matter if a family is not blood-related?　 A story of a single man in his thirties and a boy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

140098.description:
It all started with a whale, whose cultivation was all about swallowing things. This was a fantasy world crowded with spiritual monsters. Fan Lingxiao, the chief of Sky Vagabond, grew a little catfish into an all-devouring whale and became a world-famous spirit master. However, the whale somehow failed in a combat, and turned into a cruel zombie whale which swallowed Fan Lingxiao. When he woke up, everything had changed...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

140100.description:
How many kicks does it take to smash the heart of a giant? Though she’s not a pure Child of Golden Light, Loxy must learn to channel the sun’s warmth and topple the towering titans that stand in the way of saving her sister. With bloodthirsty giants in her path, and the ruthless God of the Gods, Odin, in hot pursuit, Loxy pushes her body to its very limits in the hopes that she can become half as strong as the sister that now desperately needs her help.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

140102.description:
In the middle of a scuba diving trip in the sea around Malta, Hyun-Min finds himself kidnapped to the mythical island Ogygia, where the Greek goddess Calypso is known to reside. Except...Calypso turns out to be a god, not a goddess. Not that Hyun-Min cares. He’s going to escape this place and go back to the human realm! Or, well, that’s what he plans to do. But does he really want to leave this island and Calypso behind? Little by little, the two of them find themselves drawn to each other. Can there be a happy ending for a god and a human? Or is this all destined to end in tragedy?

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: คาลิปโซที่รัก
When I woke up this morning, I thought I had become a woman, but...

title.native: 朝起きたら女になっていたと思ったけどそうでもなかった
title.romaji: Asa Okitara Onna ni Natte ita to Omotta Kedo Soudemo Nakatta

140105.description:
Mikazuchi Dormitiory, a dormitory for male high school students.
Shisui Sougo was forced to live in the dorms in order to change his bad ways. His roommate, Furube, is a perverted problem student who offers paid services in the room!
Even though he was planning to drive him out, he’s overtaken by the devilish seductiveness hiding behind those glasses…!? Aside from the title story, there’s also the younger normie and an unsociable guy included.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title.native: みんなの知らないドSな先輩
title.romaji: Minna no Shiranai Do S na Senpai
Ore wo Kuruwasu Do S na Senpai

140109.description:
Ayumu Isuzu lives in a world without sound. He may not hear the world around him, but he knows many things: that "thank you" and "sorry" look just the same in sign language and that he can't just leave this musician where he found him, all beat up like that. What can Touka and his violin bring into Ayumu's life? And what can Ayumu bring to Touka's music?

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: L'amour le plus lointain du monde

title.english: The Farthest Love in the World
title.native: 世界でいちばん遠い恋

synonyms: The Story of a Girl Who Can See Where Others Are Looking

title.native: 人からの視線が目に見える女の子の話
title.romaji: Hito kara no Shisen ga Me ni Mieru Onnanoko no Hanashi

140118.description:
According to urban legend, there’s an abandoned airfield on the edge of town where a spirit known as the Summer Ghost can be summoned. After discovering each other on the internet, three teenagers from different high schools who share a special connection to death meet up to summon the mysterious specter. Thus begins a story that will bridge the boundary between life and death on a midsummer night that none of them will ever forget.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synonyms: 私たち、どうして終わったんだっけ

title.native: なぜなぜ彼女の恋愛論
title.romaji: Naze Naze Kanojo no Koi Renairon

synonyms: Abnormal Sexual Life of Housewife Shioko-san

140125.description:
Forty-year-old Akane attends the opening of a new art exhibit by her former cram school teacher, Mr. Imai, who has now become a sculptor. Akane notices that Mr. Imai's new sculpture bears a striking resemblance to her middle school best friend, Yukari, who she remembers suddenly transferred out of the school. It even has a distinct scar that Yukari shared with Akane privately. Wondering what this could mean, Akane reaches out to her old friend, and learns that there was something else going on when they were children that she only partly understood. Was Yukari just a muse? Or something with more upsetting implications?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

140126.description: Sudou, an introvert who hides the fact he's gay, witnessed Yuki, his neighbor, get into a fight with a woman. Even though Sudou pretended not to see, he was swept away by Yuki's laid-back attitude into a night of drinking...and more.

title.native: ストップウォッチメン

140137.description:
Kyoko always thought she would end up getting married to her long-term boyfriend Kenichi. However, reality hits her like a ton of bricks when he decides to end their relationship and move to Kyushu without her. At the age of 24, she starts a new life in Tokyo, where she crosses paths with Yoichi at her workplace. His warmth tugs at her heart, and despite their 17-year age gap, she falls in love with him. However, fate has other plans, and when two other men shake up her love life, she must make the biggest decision of her life.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Taisetsu na Hi wa Itsumo Ame

title.native: 北斗の拳 世紀末ドラマ撮影伝
title.romaji: Hokuto no Ken: Seikimatsu Drama Satsuei-den

140141.description:
Two scientists—one intersex, the other a tribal priest—meet on a space station orbiting Io; but they have met before and are destined to meet again.

Notes:
First published in the artbook "Kingin Sagan (金銀砂岸)" in 1980
Published in English as a part of the "A Drunken Dream and Other Stories" manga anthology by Fantagraphics.
synonyms: A Drunken Dream and Other Stories

140144.description:
'Choi Hwan' is a promising young pianist both at home and abroad. However, in reality, he is just a 15-year-old boy confused by the identity his mother created for him.

One day before a competition, Choi Hwan's improvisation, as if pouring out his frustration in the school's music room, shakes the heart and mind of his classmate, Hwang Ina, who coincidentally passes by in hallway.
Ina, who has a special talent for art, wants to formally study art but is struggling with her family's difficult circumstances and her own heart that she herself can't even figure out.
Ina paints the emotions of that day, Choi Hwan sees it, and the two become intertwined through fate.

The story of 15-year-old children who communicate, struggle, and grow through 'music' and 'art'.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

140145.description:
A child was abandoned in a forest infested with monsters and ghosts. Woon Sowol was adopted by the five masters and learned the best magical techniques. Although the five masters are godly beings, now their inner balance is on the verge of being broken down. Woon Sowol takes revenge on behalf of his masters, and goes to the world to become a god. In the end, will Sowol be able to get out of the forest of beasts?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

140146.description:
What do you think you're doing with that axe?! When the stag god, Cheongyeon, is rescued from a hunter by a woodsman named Mooksan, he knows Mooksan is just what he's missing up in heaven. But little does Cheongyeon know, Mooksan is no ordinary woodsman...

(Source: Manta)

140147.description:
A little girl's BIG crush!

Darae's in the second grade, and she's the coolest kid in her class! She's also found her Prince Charming: her bestfriend's older brother, Inwoo. Join her as the bright and bubbly eight-year-old explores her first big crush in this story of friendship and growth.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: そらコミュニケーション

140150.description:
"You'd never get hard for a girl you hate..." But after living together with him, the unexpected gentle caress made my body and heart melt…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Wouldn't Get Hard for a Girl I Hate...
title.native: 嫌いな女に勃つわけないだろ？～むかつく同期とむさぼり同居生活
title.romaji: Kirai na Onna ni Tatsu Wakenai Daro?: Mukatsuku Douki to Musabori Doukyo Seikatsu

140151.description:
Toranosuke is in love with his childhood friend, Sumire, who's two years older than him. However, Sumire fell in love with the older brother at the coffee shop... But her first love is shattered, and as she find herself in a surprising situation, will the hero, Toranosuke, be able to protect her from danger? A mysterious love comedy between an older clumsy heroine and a younger crafty guy.

(Source: Comico, translated)

140152.description: The youthful days of a girl who rides a motorcycle, They are "DEKOBOKO" days which contains good and bad luck. Yuki Mihara will keep running at full speed!

140154.description:
In an apocalyptic world where cutting-edge technology is a relic of the past, despite his illness, Xiaosu hunts to get through each day and support his brother Liuyuan, who has a special ability related to luck. However, one day, Xiaosu unlocks a palace that offers quests in return for strength and skills. As he starts to grow while completing the quests, he starts to wonder what the palace actually is and whether he'll be able to bring down the barrier that divides the powerful from the powerless one day with his newfound power.

(Source: Tappytoon)

140155.description:
Tensei is a college student who's a hobbyist photographer. One day while taking photos, he encounters and becomes captivated by a boy with burn scars on his face, Makito. Worn down by people staring at his scars from an accident, Makito escaped the flashy modelling industry and instead found work at a small-town library. Tensei, who knows nothing about this past, comes to talk to Makito whenever he borrows and returns books. He begins to fall in love with Makito's delicate and beautiful profile, and before he knows it, he's pointing his camera at him. He's hopelessly attracted to the way Makito looks in his photos. But as he realizes his overwhelming feelings, a guy from Makito's modelling past shows up to take him back...?

College kid with a photography hobby and a hidden possessive streak × ex-model with large burn scars on his face.

"Even your scars are beautiful. I just want to mess you up..."

The story of a love affair, played out under a sky full of stars.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

140156.description:
The 'Bang family' who are said to be popular than most of the celebrities. This wealthy, prolific but humble family does not hesitate to do anything to get attention. Unfortunately, the youngest daughter, Bang Eun-hae, who pursues pathologically ordinary life among the attention seeker's family. Her life goal is to 'live like air'. However her family launches a ‘TV reality program’ which shows their daily life. The youngest daughter, Bang Eun-hae, tries to ruin the program, but rather gets the public's attention, and to make matters worse, she falls in love at first sight with the hot actress, Jang Hwi-min! In the meantime, she finds out that her childhood friend, Young-Won Nam, has a crush on her, and it is a continuation of confusion! ''A life like the air, the excitement that you feel for the first time, a being who understands you''. What should Eunhae protect and what should she give up?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes 7 side stories.

140157.description: A short, textless story about love and acceptance

140158.description:
An 89-year-old grandma passes away and wakes up in a totally different world as Grana, a teenage maid at Viscount Winston’s estate. Grana’s kind soul and her natural talents for needlework and other crafts quickly win the hearts of the Winstons and the other maids. But in this world, her skills seem somehow related to magic! As Grana makes fast friends with the young heir to the viscountcy and explores her unexpected abilities, what could possibly await her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Handmade Tales of the Handmaid

140159.description:
At 13, Dahlia Phesterose recalls her past life. She realizes she was born as the sister of the ultimate villain in a dating simulation game where the male leads, or "transcendents," all succumb to madness. Anticipating family ruin and personal peril from her estranged brother, Dahlia is desperate to escape. However, after luckily earning her terrifying brother's favor upon his return home, a new twist unfolds: she unwantedly captivates the world's strongest, the soon-to-be-mad male leads!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Strongest Characters in the World are Obsessed with Me
乙女ゲームの最強キャラたちが私に執着する
The Most Powerful Characters in the World are Obsessed with Me

title.english: The World's Strongest Are Obsessed With Me

140161.description:
"I don't know which will come first, to stop being a teacher or your mind and body to stop working..."

Nishiya is a teacher who works with the goal of being considerate to his students, but in the long working hours, complaints from parents, disobedient students and those days... He regrets choosing this path, never cease to torment him. Just at that time, crimes of cat murders occur in the area. Among the parents, it is rumored that the culprit of the crimes is a new student named Hayasaka.

synonyms: 死星マリア The beautiful Assassin who Serves God

140169.description:
The daughters of Sesshomaru and Inuyasha set out on a journey transcending time!

In Feudal Japan, Half-Demon twins Towa and Setsuna are separated from each other during a forest fire. While desperately searching for her younger sister, Towa wanders into a mysterious tunnel that sends her into present-day Japan, where she is found and raised by Kagome Higurashi’s brother, Sota, and his family.

Ten years later, the tunnel that connects the two eras has reopened, allowing Towa to be reunited with Setsuna, who is now a Demon Slayer working for Kohaku. But to Towa’s shock, Setsuna appears to have lost all memories of her older sister.

Joined by Moroha, the daughter of Inuyasha and Kagome, the three young women travel between the two eras on an adventure to regain their missing past.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: ～異伝・絵本草子～ 半妖の夜叉姫
title.romaji: Iden Ehon Zoushi: Hanyou no Yashahime

140172.description:
Urobe was a son of the great chief of Pyrimi, Africa. One day he hanged on an airplane and came to Japan. Because of the cold and hunger, he fell on to the yard of Shishio’s house, and Shishio nursed him. Kurobe was very thankful for him and began to repay for his kindness. Kurobe dig a big hole in the yard Every time he return the favor, he threw a stone into the hole until stones would fill the hole.

(Source: Anime News Network)

140174.description:
Based on the Playstation Game by the same name.

Note: Released in Enix Supercomic Gekijoh Volume 12, 13, 17, 25, 30, 33, 37, 40, 45, 49 and 55.

140176.description:
A man ten years younger, and a man of the same age appeared in front of our heroine, who had taken a break from love. A coworker, a husband, a colleague, a one night stand…. Because of the differences in position and age, they can’t say what they want to say, but instead say what they can. You don’t have to be with your soulmate… Is it enough to be with a man who fits your ideals?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

A coming-of-age pure-love story between two clumsy people.

Note: Winner of the Excellence Award at the 48th Dessert Newcomer Manga Awards

140186.description:
Treasure Hunters - Adventurers who search for buried treasure scattered around the world.
In Shinjuku, Tokyo, a young man appears as a transfer student at Kamiyoshi Academy. While he seems like a normal student, he is actually a treasure hunter. His mission is to discover a mysterious ruin hidden deep beneath the school. Accompanied by his new friends from school, he sets out to discover the mysteries of a super ancient civilization. However, numerous traps, monsters called "Kehito" that lurk within the ruins, and the clutches of the "student council" stand in his way!

(Source: Arc System Works)

140188.description:
Set in Yokohama, this is a coming-of-age manga about a man's search for the woman of his dreams, from before his birth to the age of thirty. In the course of the 26-volume manga, the protagonist, Tetsuma Hoshino, enters a variety of worlds, including motorcycle races, battles with gangsters, and the challenge of boxing. It is also characterized by the use of lyrics from hit songs of the time throughout the story.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

140189.description:
A revered war hero, Commander Li Xiao leaves the battlefield to become the Director of the Government General. On his first day of the job, he meets Hwa-Su, a high class male escort, in action. Hwa-Su seems to recognize Li Xiao from before but Li Xiao simply thinks of Hwa-Su as a disgrace to mankind for being a male escort spreading his legs for the same sex. However, by a twist of fate, Li Xiao finds himself being drawn to him...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

140190.description:
Sachiko is a prostitute living a bright and strong life of adolescence, set in the old red line of Shinjuku 2-chome.

"I don't know the pleasure of sexuality that makes me drown, but the men who have passed by my body make a joyful voice."

140191.description: A love story between a 24-year-old office worker who has neither love experience nor communication skills and a 32-year-old female shogi player he meets on his daily commute.
synonyms: Is this love a sin? Or checkmate?

title.romaji: Kono Koi wa Tsumi nano ka!?

140193.description:
Emperor High School seems to not care anymore about education, letting their students have free rein over nearly everything. The president even had to resort to teachers who came right out of a prison, because the students were so violent. One day, Ganpachi, a self declared teacher arrives, intending to bring order to this high school by introducing fear into the leader of all the gangs, Hinako. Having a hard time standing up against him, she still believes in the power of her lucky kitty gym pants.

As it turns out Ganpachi ran away from a genetic laboratory, which is probably why he has the tenacity and behavior of a cockroach.
synonyms: 恐怖のバイオ人間 最終教師
白き海の戦士たちスターロード
Shiroki umi no senshi-tachi Star Road

140197.description: Shusaku Nanbu arrives in Kanazawa from Noto to live the bunkara lifestyle. He immediately rescues a beautiful girl, Tomoko Yajima, who was about to be kidnapped by a motorcycle gang, and falls in love with her at first sight when she shows him to Seiun Dormitory, where students from other prefectures have entered. He, along with fellow newcomers Shimowaki and Ichimaru, are baptized at a welcome party by the older students in the dormitory, but Nanbu beats them all to a pulp. He enters Seisonkaku High School, which has become a den of bad guys, and joins the four demons of Seisonkaku  (a group of gang leaders; refers to Ryuuzaki no Hiryuu-tai, Torada no Byakkotai, Kumazawa no Higumatai, and Seiun Ryou no Juumonji no Gaijin Butai) show no signs of backing down, and are enthusiastically recruited by the various sports clubs. However, Nambu was begged by Tawashihige, an alumnus of the school who was staying in a remote dormitory,  to start the "Shouwa Baka Hayashi" in the defunct cheering section.

title.native: ダンシング・ファイター

140201.description:
The light and darkness of SNS...

When my illustration generated buzz online.
We were such a good friends on SNS.
But their attitude suddenly changed.

I received a message saying, "I wish you would put your brush away..."

Akihito Satake
A first-year high school boy.
He thinks he can shine more on the Internet than in real life.
His pen name is "Cotton Swab."
When he posted an illustration on SNS, it went viral.

Koharu Isshiki
A second-year high school girl.
She is in-line to be the next president of the art club.
She seems like the perfect girl to everyone's eyes, but...?

(Source: Ryuu Comics, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: I want to crush your brush

140203.description: Norman and his friends were reunited with Emma, and they all talked about their memories of the past. "Birthday", "Stormy Night", "Connie", "Chess". The secret stories that appeared in the anime DVD booklet and Jump Giga have been reedited and published in book form, with new short stories added! This is the fourth novel version filled with memories that you want to read now!
synonyms: The Promised Neverland: Films of Memories
The Promised Neverland : Au fil des souvenirs

title.native: 約束のネバーランド～想い出のフィルムたち~
title.romaji: Yakusoku no Neverland: Omoide no Film-tachi

140204.description:
"Starting today, I am your pet" says the yakuza who forced his way into my house...!? I don't care if he says he'll answer to my every order, he's just a bother...!

(Source: Coolmic)

140205.description:
Yuuma, the unpopular host, summoned the incubus demon, Airucus, to grant his wishes. The contract's condition, however, was for Yuuma to give birth to Ai's child.

Yuuma is forced into conceiving a child and accepts Ai's body fluids by receiving his semen. But despite the fact that he was unable to become pregnant, Yuuma's body was in excellent condition due to the special nutrients contained in Ai's semen.

Yuuma became clingy after that and began to beg for Ai's semen himself—!?? Whether he gives birth to an incubus demon child or remains an unpopular host—- It's a difficult decision!!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: オメガと悪魔のセフレ事情
title.romaji: Omega to Akuma no Sefure Jijou

140206.description:
"Zero Magic? That doesn't matter to me. I'm going to save my sister!!" Abel is a boy who's always dreamed of being a mage. He is devoid of any magical powers but stays dedicated to his studies of magic to save his sister from a curse placed on her by a powerful deity. All it took was one old book to change his life forever. In this book lies a powerful word: "Science". And so begins a new adventure fusing the fundamentals of Magic and Science... the path to becoming the most powerful Mage!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Mighty Zero-Magic Mage: I Knew Something Was Wrong With Your Theories On Magic!
title.native: 魔力ゼロの最強魔術師～やはりお前らの魔術理論は間違っているんだが？～@COMIC
title.romaji: Maryoku Zero no Saikyou Majutsushi: Yabari Omaera no Majutsu Riron wa Masakatte Iru n da ga? @COMIC

140208.description:
Leading his troops by day, Tenma Sawatari is the captain of the Special Operations Unit, formed to handle incidents with beastmen. With his inherited beastmen genes, he's stronger than the average human, but he is quick to lose control and rampage when injured. To help surpress his instincts, he begs his subordinate and childhood friend, Kazami, for help. Only when the two have sex can he calm down. The only problem is they are human and beastman! How will this relationship between superior and suboridinate unfold?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ケダモノに跪くは夜の下僕
title.romaji: Kedamono ni Hizamazu wa Yoru no Geboku

140209.description: High school girl Noko loves pandas very much. One day by chance she finds a baby panda, whom she calls Ai Ai, and she decides to raise them.

140210.description:
Small body, big dreams! The passionate youth handball DAYS begin!

Handball, known as the sport in the sky. In a game where "height" is an overwhelming advantage, Ishino Mikage is no taller than an elementary school student when he joins the handball team at Fuuchou High School! Even so, he is armed with a "heaven and earth" shot given to him by his father, a star athlete. This is the story of Mikage working to achieve his dreams with his friends...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated and edited)

140211.description:
Gu Gu, a shy girl, meets Xing Xing, an extroverted basketball girl. Xing Xing is everything Gu Gu wants to be - have lots of friends and live a happy, carefree life with dreams. Gu Gu is organized; she lists out a long to-do list for herself. But how does that help her get closer to Xing Xing? Wait, maybe Xing Xing is trying to get closer to Gu Gu too...

(Source: Webcomics)

140215.description:
When a struggling vlogger meets a superstar writer, what could go wrong? Everything! Nothing has gone right since meeting her!

Hu Luoluo, on the brink of losing her vlogger contract, gets involved with the scandal-ridden writer Song Li purely by accident. All of a sudden, they've become a trending topic, touted as a couple, and blowing up her viewer traffic... Is this what it takes to finally make it as a vlogger?

(Source: Dongman, translated)

140220.description: Rikidouzan retired from the world of sumo even though he was a Yokozuna at the time. As he searched for a second career, the way of life of Musashi Miyamoto inspired him to become a professional wrestler. First, in Hawaii, he defeated opponents one after another with the "karate chop," a special move inspired by Musashi's two-fisted style. Eventually, Rikidozan went to mainland U.S. to experience the full world of professional wrestling. And even in a foreign country where anti-Japanese sentiment still lingered, he gradually won the hearts of the people with his strength and personality.

140221.description: Jun Jun, independent private eye, solves hi-tech crimes and busts criminals using her feminine wit and charm, and also with the help of her homemade gadgets. An occasional enemy is Dr. Nekura, AKA the most evil genius in the world, who's desperate to prove he's better than everyone (especially Jun Jun).

140225.description: A story about two classmates enjoying their summer vacation together.
synonyms: The Summer Vacation of These Two in the Corner

title.native: すみっこ二人の夏休み

140241.description:
In a palace ruthlessly torn apart by political schemes for the throne... The story of a king, blinded by his relentless pursuit of ambition, and his bodyguard.

"I've heard great rumors of your loyalty exceeding any and all expectations. l'd like to put your devotion to the test.."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

140242.description: At the Engetsuza Shrine, there's a magical tale that’s been passed down through each generation about what happens when a male descendant falls in love. The priest's son, Kounosuke, is a very ordinary high school student. Every day he takes care of his childhood friend, Shu, a relax and laid-back guy. When suddenly one morning, Kounosuke realizes he’s in love with Shu… and a strange change to his body starts to occur.

Short stories by the highly acclaimed manga artist Shinichi Sugimura, who is highly acclaimed in various fields—now is the time to read them!

Contemporary and nostalgic, complex and slapstick, sad and kinetic... Please enjoy these seven manga of concentrated entertainment.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

140253.description: Tetsuya Nakanishi is a trapeze artist working in a circus troupe in Hawaii. He started boxing after being discovered by former boxer Jimmy Smith, and won many fights and overcame many crises with his special punch, the "cross-shaped triple strike," which he adapted from his father, a famous Zero pilot. After winning the championship in New York, Tetsuya returned to Japan, his parents' home country, with Coach Smith, his daughter Marie, and his best friend Sanpei to make it in the Japanese boxing world.

A spiteful virgin one day finds himself turned into the girl of his dreams, but he isn't alone...

(Source: FAKKU!)

140261.description:
Tsubasa is a new male teacher who just reunited with his old playboy childhood friend Tatsuya.

Tsubasa tries to set him straight, but Tatsuya uses some kind of magic to turn Tsubasa into a young and attractive woman...! Totally bewildered by the turn of events, Tsubasa is helpless to fend off Tatsuya.

Thus begins 'her' sexual training...
Tsubasa's body, mind... and even memory will all succumb to Tatsuya's technique in no time at all.

(Source: DLsite)

140266.description:
Another world is quite hard to understand! A fantasy of a hardworking girl's DIY struggle!

One day, Kurisu, a girl who was born and raised in a remote area, learns that she has the [House Building Skill]. When her memories of being Kurisu Niina, a Japanese woman, come back to her, she decides to leave the remote area and become an adventurer. After a grueling journey, she arrives in the labyrinthine city of Garel, and tries to build her own house and enjoy living alone, but the officials tell her that people from other countries can't even live there permanently. Thinking, "If so, let's make a house where you can travel!", she remodels a used carriage and begins to make an ideal home.

Now begins the story of a girl who lives single-mindedly in a different world where her life depends on her skills!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

140267.description: This is a slapstick comedy about Dameo Marude, a fourth grader who is completely hopeless at studying, and Borot, a clunky robot invented by his scientist father, Hagetero.

140268.description:
In search of his missing parents, Jiro Suzuki attended an a-capella school, hoping to learn the ways of karaoke, even though he's hopelessly tone-deaf. It turned out his true musical abilities were being inhibited by the collar placed on him when he was a child.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title.native: カラオケ戦士マイク次郎

140269.description:
For 500 years, a giant snake god has lived in the ancient mountain. Miyo, an unlucky young woman from the nearby village, has been offered as a tribute: she is to be the snake’s bride. Miyo always feared that the enormous talking snake would devour her whole, but once she’s taken in by the god, he treats her like a wife rather than a meal. His flicking tongue vibrates through gentle words, his powerful slithering body wraps around hers in an embrace. This god is kinder than his monstrous form implies, and Miyo thinks she could learn to appreciate the non-human form his love takes. What does it truly mean to be the bride of a beast…?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Girl Who Married the Big Snake

140273.description:
January 13, 2020, on Coming of Age Day, 20-year-old Nisshin Tomori has a boy she really wants to see again… Meanwhile, Kai Ichikawa, also 20, is also looking for Nisshin… Six men and women who have reached the age of 20 gather with twenty years of memories in their hearts! Six men and women with strong personalities will laugh, cry, and fall in love!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

140274.description:
If the girls say no, just get down on your knees and beg for it! All the fun pages where you can see the girls' breasts and underwear in full color! Working girls from all walks of life make an appearance!

140277.description:
Suzu Akio, 32 years-old. He dislikes dealing with people but likes smoking, drinking and cats. In a town with a mountain that rains ashes on it, Suzu's days stay the same and time passes by without him ever being concerned about trying to change it.

One day, when he went to deliver goods to a regular customer, a person who will throw his life into disarray appeared. Yutaka is the couple's nephew who has come from Tokyo and he attempts to break through the wall that Suzu has put up in his rejection towards human connections.

Here's a warm yet heartrending and somewhat bittersweet story of platonic love between two awkward men.

(Source: GOT, translated)

140281.description:
He's still a virgin on his 30th birthday, and now he's fallen in love... Shinichiro Hirose is a stern businessman who can only boast about how much money he has in savings, and he hires an escort so he can lose his virginity before his 30th birthday. The escort who shows up is a young, polite, pretty, and nice-smelling guy named "Yodaka." Even though he knows Yodaka's a professional, because he's kind and attractive, Shinichiro falls for him. However, Yodaka has a dark past... Is it possible to buy "true love" with money!? This is a love story involving money between a stern, inexperienced businessman with plenty of cash to spare and a male escort with a secret!

(Source: Renta!)

140286.description:
Aya Kitaryu, a Hokkaido girl who is a popular hostess in the Susukino district, ends up being seduced herself by a mysterious woman, Suzuka Kuromizu, who picks her up and sets off on a journey in her beloved Roadster. The story depicts the dreams and passions of the desperate women of the nightlife district. Their sins will chase after them even when they run away. What started as a casual relationship between the two women now leads them to the northern lands in search of a true bond!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Want to Be Tried by Northern Women

140287.description:
Two years ago, high schooler Kanae left his small island community of Sodeshima to pursue his academic dreams in Tokyo. When that life falls short of his expectations, he runs away from home to return to Sodeshima to find his childhood friend, Akari. But before they can rekindle their old feelings for each other, the clock strikes six and Kanae finds himself inexplicably thrust forward four days into the future. Worse, he learns that Akito, Akari’s older brother—and Kanae’s childhood hero—is dead.

Except death might not be the end for Akito. As Kanae tries to fill in the four-day gap of his memories, Akari explains: he’s about to relive those four days in reverse order in a phenomenon known as “Rollback.” Kanae himself explained it to her…in a past he hasn’t yet experienced. Armed with this new knowledge, Kanae is determined to leverage Rollback however he can to save Akito’s life—and Akari’s heart.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Wait For Me Yesterday in Spring
title.native: きのうの春で、君を待つ
title.romaji: Kinou no Haru de, Kimi wo Matsu

140288.description: "If I'm not attracted to the things that most girls are attracted to... Is there something wrong with me?" Amane Shizuku has been worried about a possible sexual frigidity. She can fall in love with men, she's even dated some of them, but when things were about to go to the next level, her heart didn't throb at all. Due to this matter, she was about to give up on love, but when she meets the popular Kouki, her world changes... literally!!

140289.description:
In an alternate Japan, where the Second World War has suddenly came to an end, a disturbed man returned from the war zone to the imperial capital as it was enjoying a brief period of peace. His name is Kihei Janome, also known as "the demon soldier who killed a thousand people." He escaped being sent to the execution chamber, but when a strange priestess gave him a mysterious command, Kihei was forced to the fierce "front lines" of a new war.

(Source: Shonen Magazine, translated)

140290.description: For an Osaka boy, it's better to be funny than handsome, eh?

140292.description:
The stage is set when Ichirou Gomen, a newbie producer of the record company Gaia loses yet another production opportunity to inexperience. Wanting to pass on his childhood dreams of stardom to a fledgling singer, he toils learning the process day by day through failure.

However, his life is sent into a loop when he follows a beautiful performing voice, the voice of Jam Hiiragi, playing live to a group of homeless people at a streetside. Wrangling the prodigy talent and her bratty complications, together they face off and challenge the professional world of the music industry.

140293.description:
A future in which a world war has brought about the development of technology. Men have made robots to do most of the work. The increase in cyborgs, more intelligent and autonomous, engenders a certain hatred on the part of men, despising and degrading them. Some of them have banded together to form the Cyborg Liberation Front led by a certain Damos, who is seeking the right to live like ordinary citizens.
The policeman,MX-16, finds himself getting involved in the conflict somewhat by chance. In a fight between rebel cyborgs of the Metal Brain group and police robots, he loses his wife. Desperate, he finally agrees to take home a cyborg with all of her memories in order to alleviate the grief of his son Gun. But MX-16 is unable to get used to this presence and during this time, the revolt is brewing...

title.native: 江戸っ子ボーイ がってん太助

140295.description:
Koki, a tattoo artist, has excellent tattooing and designing technique, but he wasn’t interested in people and had a difficult personality. Mia, Koki’s only regular customer who had a certain obsession with “pain” stemming from his early life, begged him to tattoo all of his designs on his body. Koki gradually fell for Mia’s unhinged and dangerous allure, but his true feelings remained yet to be seen. But what will happen to their faint relationship like a thin spider’s thread?

(Source: INKR)

140296.description:
“I want you more, Masafumi.” The relationship between Kei Higuchi and Masafumi Tsurumi, which was just for the sake of a single artwork, has slowly started to progress. Are they classmates, friends, or lovers? Kei is unable to ask him, thinking that everything will come to an end if he makes an assertion. Masafumi thinks he their relationship is obvious, which ends up in misunderstanding. What will happen to their relationship which was supposed to just be physical and would eventually end?

(Source: INKR)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

140297.description:
After awakening in a webnovel as Princess Clara, this former office worker isn’t getting the royal treatment. As the shy sister of the tyrannical King Bastian, she’s immediately faced with disdain and so much drama! Plus her character's destined to be seduced by his latest hostage, Crown Prince Daniel, accused of betrayal, and executed. But Clara’s got a backbone and a plan to win over her brother. She’s ready to take control, slap some sense into meddling nobles and servants, and resist the charms of her handsome (really handsome) charge!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Tried To Persuade My Brother But He Entrusted The Male Lead To Me
お兄様を誘惑するつもりだったのに！

title.english: Catching Two Birds with One Sweet Princess

140298.description:
"I want to rub some boobs--------~~~!"

"If I let you rub my boobs, will you go out with me...?"

An ordinary high school boy, Natsuhiko Umboi, now has his first girlfriend. It's a love story about an ideal couple dedicated to all who love boobs!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

140299.description:
After I finished my SAT’s I was reading a novel about the pitiful Ludia who had no partner. The friend of the stalker villainess, who gets her executed. The pushover who followed her friend that brought her doom, also known as extra 1. ...Why do I remember an extra who’s of no importance?

Damn it, I became that Ludia! I made up my mind that I won’t die miserably and live on but…

Hello, crown prince. Why are you straying away from the female lead, and keep getting entangled with me? And why does he get so delusional!!

“What should I do? What if the crown prince really fell in love with me…”
“Hm, that would never happen.”
“Why?”
“He was with me last night.”

Since it happened this way, I might as well just snatch this man?!

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
synonyms: Suddenly I Decided to Become the Female Lead

140300.description:
“Die for us, just like you’ve served our family all along.”

Because of her crimson eyes and the dark splotch on her face, Arryl Brixia, the illegitimate child of the Brixia ducal house, had to live with a mask on her entire life. She tried desperately to win the acceptance of her family, but in the end, she met her death after being framed for treason.

But now, she’s returned to the past. She can no longer see the hideous splotch in her reflection in the mirror. But her face isn’t the only thing that’s changed from before — Ethan, the heir to the Burstein ducal family, suddenly comes and finds her…

“Lady Arryl, why do you wear a mask?”
“Why do you ask?”
“Your eyes.”
“What?”
“I saw your eyes. Your clear and confident eyes.”
“People fear them because they believe it’s the sign of the devil. Don’t you think so, Sir Ethan?”
“No, not at all. They look absolutely beautiful to me.”

The satisfying revenge story of Lady Arryl Brixia, who was abandoned by her own family.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: A promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter Is Going on Strike
The Princess Is Going on Strike

140301.description:
I’m Selena, a daughter born to a family well-known for their fertile women. I was all but sold off in a marriage to a sickly duke whose life hung in the balance, all for the sake of producing an heir for his family. They provided me a medicine purported to aid in pregnancy, and the astrologist advised me good days for sleeping together, but... there was no child.

“So, are there any signs of pregnancy?”
“Ah, I-I'm sorry.”
“You’re useless. What luck do you think won you the position of the duke's wife?”

I couldn't say a word.

"No, excuse me. I only have to look at the sky to pluck a star. That's how I attained this position.*"

*Metaphor: Lit. Plucking a star from the sky: something that's difficult to get/achieve)

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: A promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

140302.description:
I was reborn as an extra character in a novel whose soul was sucked to death from the villain. If you were reincarnated, what would you do?

For eighteen years, I lived under various abuses as a s*ave for my family. Fortunately, before my parents forced me to be sold to the villain like in the original novel, I succeeded in running away. I spent a short but happy time with Momo, a stray dog I met in a rural village. But three months later, the pampered puppy disappeared! To make matters worse, I was captured by my family and was given to the villain.

The moment I was discouraged when I was about to die,

“Why are you so surprised? It’s me, Momo, your puppy.”

My beloved pet turned into a villain? And that villain is my “fated counterpart”?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
synonyms: When My Pet Became the Villain

140308.description:
While running away from her wedding, Qian Duoduo falls into a lake and dies due to a miscalculation. She is then transmigrated into the body of Mu Yunkai, a princess of the former dynasty who is being hunted. If she can max out the affinity values of all the gorgeous men the system has set up as targets, she will be able to return to her original world and have a second chance at life! This should have been a happy adventure of embracing beautiful men, but why do all the guys arranged by the system… want to kill her?!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Paohui Gongzhu Xiang Gou Dao Zuìhou

140309.description:
"You are born to be his bride. Once you marry him, our family business can secure the biggest support." That's what I've been told and instructed to do growing up. I feel like a prisoner of my family. Everything is suffocating! Fine, just lock up my feelings and consider my marriage as pure business—I will like whatever he likes, wear whatever he prefers, and behave whichever way he fancies. Just marry him and get this over for good! However, we did grow up together and were once childhood sweethearts. What if... he really loves me and wants the best for me?

(Source: MangaToon)

140310.description: What if Miyamoto Musashi was actually a ninja, and he defeated Sasaki Kojiro using the power of ninjutsu...

140311.description: In 1962, Isao Shibata debuted as a pitcher for the Giants, but his talent was overlooked and he was told to switch to the field. A young girl named Kiriko appeared in front of the discouraged Shibata and presented him with a secret book of Kouga Ninjutsu that she found by chance in her hometown. With her encouragement, Shibata vowed to make a fresh start as a fielder, and learned the secrets of the ninja arts written in the book one by one.

140313.description:
Suna no Tsurugi is a collection of stories that take place at the end of WWII. Susumu Higa gives us an inside look at the battle of Okinawa, from the first signs to the aftermath, through different points of view of inhabitants, soldiers, Japanese and American, in this war where there is neither good nor evil, neither good nor bad, only a cruel sense of absurdity. The men are in turn overwhelmingly stupid, full of wisdom or infinitely touching by their humanity. Because Higa's work has something deeply generous, which is also felt in his simple and precise lines.

(Source: Le Lézard Noir, translated)

140314.description:
When a haughty and spoiled lady died, her body was taken over by the soul of a 21st-century medical genius. With her modern smarts and medical knowledge, she'll take on unfriendly in-laws, uncaring husband, and jealous concubines. In the warlord's mansion, armed with just her scalpel, she confronted the scheming women and easily saw through their tricks. As she won over the household, the husband who treated her like an annoying fly started taking her seriously, and came back to her promising to be a loving couple. Even as another playboy heir had become her willing lapdog, who comes and goes as she commands...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

He came from the wilderness carrying the destiny of the human race. He had numerous disciples and brought up twelve emperors for the human race! Heehee, having raised so many boys, now I need a girl disciple to rub my back!

140324.description:
A poignant coming-of-age story about a young woman coming into her own as she discovers her identity as aromantic asexual. A complete story in a single volume, from the creator of Mine-kun is Asexual.

When it comes to love, high schooler Chika wonders if she might be an alien. She's never fallen for or even had a crush on anyone, and she has no desire for physical intimacy. Her friends tell her that she just "hasn't met the one yet," but Chika has doubts... It's only when Chika enters college and meets peers like herself that she realizes there's a word for what she feels inside--asexual--and she's not the only one. After years of wondering if love was the answer, Chika realizes that the answer she long sought may not exist at all--and that that's perfectly normal.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

140328.description:
Noah can't forget the magical words "you are so cute" that Haruyuki repeatedly said to him when he was still a young boy. The two were close like brothers, but it's been six years since they last saw each other. Noah's grown tall and isn't exactly the "cute" boy he used to be anymore. He is worried and saddened by the thought that Haruyuki might not recognize him when they meet again. One day after school, he runs into Haruyuki...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 獣攻遊撃隊 アカツキ

140331.description:
The story is set in Japan's Warring States period. It follows Tono, a man who was once a fearful god on the battlefield but has fallen into poverty and is now living in a tenement house, and a dog that he picks up despite his inadequate daily life. Tono is pushed around by the dog, who does not listen to him and spends its time freely and unrestrainedly.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)
synonyms: A Fearful Lord and a Cheerful Dog Live Together as Masters and Servants!

140332.description: 1966. A story based on real life events. The Sanrizuka Struggle, told from the perspective of the peasants fighting for their land.

140334.description:
Seiran Island is a place like no other, to deter emigration and attract tourism they have become the 'sex' destination as residents are punished if they are not have having frequent sex! On this crazy island, Hotori Misaki is still at school and one of the rare virgins trying to keep her secret and find love in such a lewd environment!

Note: It was announced on October, 2021 that the publishing rights of the manga were acquired by Shueisha. The manga started being published on the Ultra Jump magazine since November 18, 2021.

140335.description:
With that cold look, he feels this urge growing in his stomach...

Makoto Tsuge and Kyouya Shirane have been friends since their sophomore year in high school. Makoto's friendly and gets along with everyone, but Kyouya's more of a loner who does what he wants and often picks on other people. Despite their polar differences, they've managed to stay friends into their adult years. However, the truth is they've each been working very hard to stay close to one another...

This is the love story between a plain, friendly businessman and a fancy-free, gorgeous beast. Their ten-year relationship will turn into a loving one, and the key to that is their second kiss.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kimi ga Kagi wo Akeru made

Please don't ever forget anything about me...

(Source: Fakku!)

140339.description:
I lived to the age of 19, only to be constantly taken advantage of by fake family members. With the vow to seek revenge still fresh in my mind, I made the choice to live my life again. Yet why have I returned to the night I was kidnapped from a burning castle?

"Hwelp me! Hwelp me! The willian ish twaking Maedie!"

My savior ended up being the enemy's son?! For days and nights I followed him to the enemy's castle, but upon arrival, a warm welcome...

"Ack! Father! Second Brother's picked up another living thing!"

...wasn't what awaited me.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: Webcomic prologue of the homonym web novel.

140380.description:
I don't care as long as I don't lose any credits, I just have to show up at school for the minimum number of days. Even if I studied hard and go to college, I would just become a salaryman or something like that anyway.

As I sat at home, that was the kind of bleak future I envisioned for myself. But in the spring of my senior year, I met you, the wild and naive girl who was more dedicated to her dreams than anyone else I've ever met, and I was touched by your straightforward enthusiasm.

Two people who were supposed to be complete opposites became drawn to each other. But a choice hangs in the balance between finding love and realizing their dreams.

Face your true self, say goodbye to the past, and let your youthful energy bloom into spring!

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

Asato Kanami was summoned as a hero to another world, Istalia, to stop the war between the demons and humans. It is said that he was summoned by Anna, the Saint of the Kingdom of Elshnon.

After a year of war, Asato finally challenges the Demon King, Lione. However, just when he thought the battle was over, his summoner Anna attacked both him and the Demon King. But Asato survived the attack and was protected by the Demon King.

What is the future path for the hero betrayed by humans...!?

Snake bugs, bone bugs, skull bugs, flesh bugs, blood bugs, poisonous death bugs. This is the very bottom of hell, the wriggling poisonous bugs of hell. Death bugs, organ bugs, maggot demon bugs. Tempted by the moans of the dead, the poisonous bugs' counting song. Eat the flesh, eat the bones, suck the blood, tear out the innards. Poisonous Princess of Hell, devour the evil!

(Source: Sukima, translated)

140397.description:
A collection of Hideshi Hino's early works:

1. Bokura no Sensei (ぼくらの先生)
2. Oooi Namazu-kun (おーいナマズくん)
3. Kawaii Shoujo (かわいい少女)

140398.description: Who lives in that mansion devoured by ivy? The solidly barred gate has not been opened for a long time, yet they say the house is inhabited by the Lord of Insects. Every time Yuri passes by on his way to school, he feels two piercing eyes on her. They belong to the man who lives in that cursed house! Yet Yuri, dragged by a sinister call, decides to cross the threshold... she doesn't know that the gates of hell have just opened wide!

140399.description:
A family lives a peaceful life. But next door stands a creepy Western-style mansion known as the Ghost House, but it has been vacant for many years. The nightmare begins when the Dokuro family moves in. Then, a number of children go missing in the town. Meanwhile, the family sees a ghostly child in the Ghost House and calls the police. They also find the body of a missing child, but what is that body? What is the Dokuro family's goal? And will they be able to restore peace?

(Source: Sukima, translated)
